It's a bizarre concept for swampy DC politicians. I've always believed you deserve the truth --even when it's not what you want to hear. That 's why I never understood the point of sending you fake gimmicks, imaginary donor matches, or emails claiming you're somehow "off the team" if you don't chip in. You deserve better than that. Last month, I was blown away by the overwhelming response I received from Patriots like you. You stepped up to the plate and showed exactly why our movement is the strongest political force America has ever seen. Because you had my back, I wanted to give you a quick, honest update on how things look from the inside this week. You deserve to know where things stand. Right now, here are the top 3 things Republican leaders are talking about behind closed doors: 1. National Democrats and their liberal dark money donors have officially raised over $1 BILLION dollars to flip the House. 2. Far-left socialist candidates are winning Democrat primaries across the country. 3. President Trump has warned that if Democrats take back the House, impeachment will be back on the table on day one. I won't sugarcoat it. We hold one of the slimmest House majorities in nearly 100 years. Democrats are preparing for an all-out fight, and they'll spend whatever it takes to win back the majority. If they succeed, the America First agenda won't just slow down--it will grind to a halt. Now, I'm not sharing this to scare you, and I'm certainly not going to pressure you into making some massive donation. You get enough texts and emails threatening you to donate, and quite frankly, it upsets me to no end. That is flat-out wrong. I won't tell you how to spend your hard-earned money. That's your choice. | | Dear Peter,
We have a historic opportunity to elect the first ever revolutionary socialist to the US Congress. This can only happen if we have an army of thousands of volunteers to turn out tens of thousands of votes for Kshama Sawant in the primary election by August 4th. We need to place in the top two among primary candidates to move on to the general election. Ballots are now being mailed out for this race, so we need you to be part of this fight by volunteering with our campaign.
Working people are furious at the endless wars, the astronomical cost of basic necessities, and the fact that the rich keep getting richer, and they are extremely excited by the demands Kshama is running on. But we face the opposition from both political parties of capitalism, and we also face the reality that most working people do not vote in primary elections because they are accustomed to seeing no one on that ballot that is fighting for them. We will have to do all we can to make this not a normal election, and to turn out huge numbers of people to vote for Kshama.
[**Join us for a phone banking shift virtually from whatever city you are in to help us fight for every possible vote to elect the socialist who beat the billionaires.**](https://us.list-manage.com/oUgwBBW8CIY?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
This is the most important campaign in the country and it would be a political earthquake in national and world politics if Kshama were to win. We have seen the popularity of Kshama's track record and demands when we go out and talk to working people, but elections ultimately come down to votes, and so we need every single person who has supported Kshama to sign up right now to join us for phonebanking. We will talk to voters about Kshama's history of winning the highest minimum wage in the nation, the Amazon Tax, and landmark renters' rights, and we'll get people excited by the demands like ending all military aid to Israel, and taxing the rich to fund free healthcare for all. We'll help them understand why this campaign is so important, and we'll convince as many people to vote as soon as they get their ballot.
Even if you have never volunteered for a campaign before, we need your help. Each phonebank has an experienced campaign organizer leading it to help with any questions and give detailed instructions so things go as smoothly as possible. Any amount of time you can donate to this campaign will go a long way in our overall chances to win. If we win, it will be a major blow to the capitalist class and both their warmongering parties. Sign up now to phonebank - we have [scheduled phonebanks](https://us.list-manage.com/HoJsIq1cUA6?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) nearly every single day and we need you to participate. Let's do all we can to defeat AIPAC and the political establishment, and elect the socialist who beat the billionaires!
[**Join us for a phone banking shift virtually from whatever city you are in to help us fight for every possible vote to elect the socialist who beat the billionaires.**](https://us.list-manage.com/ryFPMi1HRRF?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

---

| |
**Primary Ballots are arriving in homes this week!**
Opponents are attacking Michael on billboards, on TV, and on social media because they do not support the conservative values of the Fifth District.
Money is pouring in from out of state to help Michael’s challengers. We need to show them that he has local support.
The Congressman is doorbelling this weekend in a push to get people to return their ballots. _He’d love for you to join us!_
**Liberty Lake, Spokane****This Saturday, July 18th** Meet at 2:00 PM at _Town Square Park._
**********We’ll be knocking on doors all afternoon. I’d like to be able to tell Michael that you’ll be there.**
This is a great opportunity to connect directly with voters and hand out literature door to door. We’ll have a chance to share Michael’s strong record of delivering results for Eastern Washington, and help ensure conservative voters remember to vote in this vital primary.
No experience necessary. We will provide the walk sheets, training, and plenty of support.
Whether you can help for 1 hour, 2 hours or 3 hours, your help makes a difference!
_**You can RSVP by replying to this e-mail.**_
If you can’t make Liberty Lake on Saturday, we have other volunteer activities sign-waving, doorbelling and putting out yard signs for the next three weeks until the August 4th deadline for returning ballots.

See you on Saturday! And thank you for all your support.
Best regards, Stephanie Campaign Staff Michael Baumgartner for Congress

| | Hey Peter,
I just left the Capitol and I am furious.

Republicans came to Congress promising fiscal responsibility.

Now they’re threatening to add another $100 billion to the national debt - including billions to fund Donald Trump’s reckless war in Iran without congressional authorization.

I voted no.

This isn’t responsible. It’s compulsive borrowing and it’s the third time Republicans have done it in less than two years.

First, they passed a bill adding more than $4.5 trillion to the debt. Then they handed ICE and CBP another $70 billion. Now, they want taxpayers to finance another massive spending package with virtually no accountability?

I offered an amendment requiring basic guardrails for ICE and CBP - standards to prevent taxpayer dollars from funding abusive, unconstitutional enforcement.

Republicans voted it down.

They are willing to spend billions more on masked agents, military-grade equipment and tearing families apart but unwilling to demand even the most basic accountability for how that money is used - even after the violence and tragedy in Houston and Maine this week.

I won’t stop fighting this reckless spending or the fear it is inflicting on families in San Diego and across the country.

Standing up to this Republican majority is going to take resources. They are digging in and they aren’t going to give up without a fight.

Enough.

Back in 2025, when I was beginning to think about running in this election, I met a man who had lived in Roanoke his entire life and clearly cared about the people in the county. I could hear the frustration in his voice about conditions in the county. He kept talking about being afraid of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBA). I asked him if it was really that bad. He paused for a long moment and said, "Randolph County has been on a precipice for a long time, and if they pass that bill, we're going over the edge, and nothing is going to stop it."
The OBBA passed on July 4, 2025. Mike Rogers, Randolph County's Congressman, voted for it twice. When I heard the OBBA had passed, I think that was when I knew something had to be done.
It's been a year. It's time to take stock of the OBBA and its impact on working-class Americans over the past 12 months.

Over 300 were arrested within three days. While some were taken into custody for simply being illegally present in the country, others had extensive criminal histories. You can read my full report about it here.

2 days ago * 14 likes * 2 comments * Julio Rosas
While arrests were taking place during traffic stops, local anti-ICE activists and trackers showed up to film. Even though Florida is very pro-law enforcement, the immigrant community in the county is active with sharing alerts on ICE or FHP presence on social media.
I decided to see what the anti-ICE activists had to say and the conversations went as expected, it was like talking to a brick wall that was playing dumb.
My first interaction was with a man who had to be told to obey the state's "Halo Law," which requires people to stay at least 25 feet from where officers are carrying out their official duties.

subject: TAKE ACTION: Protect your drinking water from PFAS chemicals!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM4NDE1OTMS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjUwMDA5NzQ5OAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell the EPA: Keep PFAS out of Our Drinking Water!

Trump’s EPA is proposing to roll back limits on PFAS, or “forever chemicals,” in
our drinking water. These chemicals are linked to cancers, kidney and liver
damage, hormone disruption, reproductive harms, immune system disruption, birth
defects, and more. This is yet another hand out to corporate polluters, giving
them a free pass to poison our drinking water while they rake in profits.

We all deserve access to PFAS-free water that doesn’t make us sick. Take action
today to protect safe, healthy drinking water — for yourself, your family, and
for all of our communities.

Comments are open until July 20th. Tell the EPA today: don’t allow PFAS poison into our drinking water! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfE~x3xH2/UUtURWRyeTlyM1U5NUtOMi9aNTF2MkEvOXlIRWZmM1BxN2dHVDZTVmNWd1o5aHh4ZGFNZ1ViZHhJZURna2YxU2ZORWhBcXJjcDZNcUEwd24vSU8xV3NTdi9Ed3BVWFVlYnAvSXUxTmw0NTA9S0/SkdJYWZYaUM4TjBDOTNNbEx6VVVLTHRnR1JLZXBPNkNHcmdJb05seDk2YVo5czVOYjk0Z1VuZUpzYlBteXV3MWtBei9FdG1DeC82SDd2MzVST20yMm0xTlgzVGJWMXlENzAzVldXTkl6NE09S0 ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF6_0d0sY/UUtURWRyeTlyM1U5NUtOMi9aNTF2MkEvOXlIRWZmM1BxN2dHVDZTVmNWd1o5aHh4ZGFNZ1ViZHhJZURna2YxU2ZORWhBcXJjcDZNcUEwd24vSU8xV3NTdi9Ed3BVWFVlYnAvSXUxTmw0NTA9S0/SkdJYWZYaUM4TjBDOTNNbEx6VVVLTHRnR1JLZXBPNkNHcmdJb05seDk2YVo5czVOYjk0Z1VuZUpzYlBteXV3MWtBei9FdG1DeC82SDd2MzVST20yMm0xTlgzVGJWMXlENzAzVldXTkl6NE09S0 Peter, Once again, Trump’s EPA is abandoning the agency’s mission of protecting human
health and the environment. This time, they’re proposing to roll back limits on
PFAS, or “forever chemicals,” in our drinking water. These chemicals are linked
to cancers, kidney and liver damage, hormone disruption, reproductive harms,
immune system disruption, birth defects, and more. It’s time to act — comments are open until July 20th. Tell the EPA today: don’t allow PFAS poison into our drinking water! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~G_r_hw/UUtURWRyeTlyM1U5NUtOMi9aNTF2MkEvOXlIRWZmM1BxN2dHVDZTVmNWd1o5aHh4ZGFNZ1ViZHhJZURna2YxU2ZORWhBcXJjcDZNcUEwd24vSU8xV3NTdi9Ed3BVWFVlYnAvSXUxTmw0NTA9S0/SkdJYWZYaUM4TjBDOTNNbEx6VVVLTHRnR1JLZXBPNkNHcmdJb05seDk2YVo5czVOYjk0Z1VuZUpzYlBteXV3MWtBei9FdG1DeC82SDd2MzVST20yMm0xTlgzVGJWMXlENzAzVldXTkl6NE09S0 Every community deserves access to healthy, clean water.The current drinking water standards, which are backed by science and have been
hard won by communities across the country, acknowledge the linkage between PFAS
exposure and severe health impacts. Rolling back standards that safeguard our
families from illnesses is the opposite of ‘making America healthy again.’ We
know what this really is: yet another hand out to corporate polluters, giving
them a free pass to poison our drinking water while they rake in profits. This is a dangerous step backwards by the EPA. PFAS chemicals have already: Contaminated the drinking water of over 176 million people in the United StatesBeen detected in the blood of more than 98% of people living in the United StatesBeen connected to many harmful chronic diseases, including cancers, liver disease, reproductive harms, immune system disruption and birth defects, among others Each and every one of us has a right to know what’s in our drinking water — and
that it’s clean and safe.Rolling back these regulations will also remove requirements to regularly
monitor for PFAS, leaving communities in the dark about the presence of these
dangerous chemicals in their drinking water. We won’t sit by and let Trump’s corrupt EPA poison our communities. name: Raja Krishnamoorth
subject: Trump just dismantled a bipartisan election agency. 🚨
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.
Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.
A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.
I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.
Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.
A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.
And every single time, I have made the same choice.
Keep going.
Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.
This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.
Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch . Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.
Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.
Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect leaders who won't be intimidated — no matter what they face? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
They can scream all they want.
We are not slowing down.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

That should not be controversial. But Laura Ingraham called Seth “the worst of the worst” for saying it. name: Voto Latino
subject: Slump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Summer is always the hardest stretch for political organizations.
#
Our fundraising has taken a _serious_ dip, Peter.
We saw incredible momentum and a massive surge in support earlier this year, but our grassroots fundraising has suddenly slowed this summer.
Election Day is less than four months away, and with voter outreach and canvassing efforts across the country ramping up, we really can’t afford a slump right now. Here is exactly where our numbers stand:
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/305?c0=em-ms-voto-20260716-1.kKRNyv&refcode=em20260716-384&t=1&akid=384%2E1366028%2EftpyU6)
[**Peter, will you rush in $26 — the cost of registering one voter in a battleground district — from your city to make up for this fundraising slump and help us register and reach voters in critical battleground districts?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260716-1.tPWh0D&refcode=em20260716-384&t=2&akid=384%2E1366028%2EftpyU6)
Summer is always the hardest stretch for political organizations. We get it — a lot of people unplug to spend time with friends and family and take vacations. And fundraising naturally hits a massive slowdown.
But behind the scenes, these slower summer months are actually the most critical window of the entire election cycle. **The work we do right now is exactly what dictates who wins and who loses on the margins this November.**
Right now, our field teams are mobilizing across 9 states and 22 critical battleground districts, leading the effort to get thousands of newly eligible Latino voters on the rolls. If we wait until the fall to reach out to our community, the registration deadlines will already be closing, and it will be too late.
**We set an emergency $10,000 fundraising goal that we have to reach tonight to help to keep our field operations fully funded and bounce back from this fundraising slump.**
**[Will you rush a $26 donation or any amount today to help us get back on track and have the resources we need to reach voters during this important time?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260716-1.tPWh0D&refcode=em20260716-384&t=3&akid=384%2E1366028%2EftpyU6)**
**[Donate $26 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260716-1.tPWh0D&refcode=20260716-384&t=22&akid=384%2E1366028%2EftpyU6)**
Thank you,
Voto Latino

After leaving uniform, she kept serving by helping veterans navigate the transition back to civilian life and access the support they had earned. Now, she’s running for Congress to stop Trump’s reckless tariffs, block more tax cuts for billionaires, and keep America out of endless wars. We only need to win five seats to take back the House. AZ-6 could be one of them. Republican Juan Ciscomani is one of the most unpopular Republican incumbents in the country. Recent polling shows his favorability stands at just 29% favorable to 46% unfavorable. Ciscomani has stood with Donald Trump and Washington Republicans as they imposed reckless tariffs, cut taxes for billionaires, threatened health care coverage, and dragged our country toward more endless wars. She knows how to bring people together, make tough decisions, and stay focused on the job in front of her. She also knows this district and the challenges families are facing. She will fight to lower costs, protect health care, defend veterans, and make sure working people have someone in Congress who understands their lives. This will be a tough race. But JoAnna has the experience, discipline, and determination to win it. **Building the Patriotic Majority** I started Patriot PAC because I believe our country needs a new generation of leaders rooted in service, patriotism, and community. Veterans. Public servants. Teachers. First responders. People who have spent their lives answering the call to serve. The path forward for Democrats is not about forcing every candidate into the same ideological box. It is about electing leaders who understand sacrifice, know how to solve problems, and are willing to fight for the people they represent. JoAnna embodies that mission. She has spent her life serving our country, and now she is ready to take that same sense of duty to Congress. Together, we’re going to build a Patriotic Majority. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. He finished his speech with a push for the U.S. Senate to pass the Save America Act--the most suppressive voting law in American history that would disenfranchise millions of voters. | == It's a clear attempt by Trump to lay the groundwork for a fascist takeover of free and fair elections--an attempt to dismantle 250 years of American democracy. I might have one of the most demanding assignments in Washington right now.

\- I’m a freshman Congressman defending one of the most competitive seats in the country for the first time.
\- I'm a Democrat fighting to bring results to working families despite a broken, polarized Congress.
\- We flipped this district from red to blue by 653 votes.

For many in my position, that kind of intense pressure means playing it safe and doing just enough to survive the November election.

**That’s not how I'm doing things.**

I’m putting in the work in our communities. Every weekend, I'm on the ground in Orange County -- sitting down with local families, small businesses, and listening to what our neighbors actually need.

The Patriots for Jesus community action team held its Flag Dedication Ceremony on Wednesday June 10th at the Freeborn County Fairgrounds. These American flags will be proudly flown through the end of the Freeborn County Fair to inspire our community and remind us of America's connection to our founding Principles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7cb94788-ec1a-4123-a28c-561d4db72da7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### In one of my prouder moments in life, I was honored to install the first flag for our "paint the town red, white, and blue" initiative.
In a series of speeches leading up to his election in 1860, Abraham Lincoln frequently invoked the significance of the Declaration of Independence and how it "links the hearts of patriotic and liberty-loving people together." As we are celebrating the 250-year anniversary of this document, we are again reminded of the importance of linking our hearts to the founding principles of liberty and self-government. We must not forget that our rights do not come from the government, but from our Creator, who endowed us with certain unalienable rights, among these are Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness. Lincoln described these rights in profound terms:
"This was their majestic interpretation of the economy of the Universe. This was their lofty, and wise, and noble, understanding of the justice of the Creator to His creatures."
To those who claim that our great country was neither founded nor built upon Godly principles, I offer this challenge: make your case against the words of Honest Abe--the Great Emancipator.
During our flag dedication ceremony, I offered the following reflection:
"It was words of faith that helped build this nation. And today, I believe that words of faith can help rebuild our country and our state. Words of faith were never meant to hide in the shadows. They were meant to be a light upon the mount. A beacon that guides us through difficult times. A reminder that there is a higher authority than government, a higher calling than self-interest, and a greater purpose than our own comfort."
"Old Glory" is the symbol of these core American principles and honors the sacrifices of so many who fought to preserve these rights. Our growing group of volunteers intends to build on this initiative of "painting the town red, white, and blue" by adding more flags in future years. Patriots for Jesus is a community action team proudly affiliated with Restore MN. For more information on this growing movement, click [here.](https://substack.com/redirect/785818c7-32e8-4127-aad1-96ad955f33d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

clean_body: Patriots For Jesus community action team currently flying American Flags at the Freeborn County Fairgrounds | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Patriots For Jesus community action team currently flying American Flags at the Freeborn County Fairgrounds | | | Jul 16 | | | | | | | | | | | | The Patriots for Jesus community action team held its Flag Dedication Ceremony on Wednesday June 10th at the Freeborn County Fairgrounds. These American flags will be proudly flown through the end of the Freeborn County Fair to inspire our community and remind us of America's connection to our founding Principles. | | ---|---|--- In one of my prouder moments in life, I was honored to install the first flag for our "paint the town red, white, and blue" initiative. In a series of speeches leading up to his election in 1860, Abraham Lincoln frequently invoked the significance of the Declaration of Independence and how it "links the hearts of patriotic and liberty-loving people together." As we are celebrating the 250-year anniversary of this document, we are again reminded of the importance of linking our hearts to the founding principles of liberty and self-government. We must not forget that our rights do not come from the government, but from our Creator, who endowed us with certain unalienable rights, among these are Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness. Lincoln described these rights in profound terms: "This was their majestic interpretation of the economy of the Universe. This was their lofty, and wise, and noble, understanding of the justice of the Creator to His creatures." To those who claim that our great country was neither founded nor built upon Godly principles, I offer this challenge: make your case against the words of Honest Abe--the Great Emancipator. During our flag dedication ceremony, I offered the following reflection: "It was words of faith that helped build this nation. And today, I believe that words of faith can help rebuild our country and our state. Words of faith were never meant to hide in the shadows. They were meant to be a light upon the mount. A beacon that guides us through difficult times. A reminder that there is a higher authority than government, a higher calling than self-interest, and a greater purpose than our own comfort." "Old Glory" is the symbol of these core American principles and honors the sacrifices of so many who fought to preserve these rights. Our growing group of volunteers intends to build on this initiative of "painting the town red, white, and blue" by adding more flags in future years. Best, Coach Tommy Tuberville | Meet Coach Tuberville: Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? Peter, every decision I make starts with one question: **_How do we make sure no one gets left behind?_**
That question is personal to me. When I was growing up, I couldn’t have imagined becoming an Army Captain or CEO. _I certainly never thought I’d become Maryland’s first Black governor._
My dad passed away when I was 3. I had handcuffs on my wrists by 11. My mother didn’t get a job with benefits until I was 14.
Looking back, it’s easy to see how my story could’ve gone a very different way.
But I didn’t get here on my own. My journey was shaped by people who stepped up and invested in me -- even when they didn’t have to.
I’ll never stop fighting for the next generation, because every child deserves the chance to succeed, no matter where they come from.
It’s why we’re making historic investments in Maryland’s public schools. Fighting to make every community safer. And helping young Marylanders find a pathway to success with the Maryland Corps and Service Year Option.

body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=4gISuyR4lkj0fuOwFG46gMKjI8PXeXTZu2e2D79IDwKvjhaeHq2i8mSMeHwiulpfqgXlI93I/di96nn1Z2Dn+qySgJedicUPmsL85ydOWFtXdylstoz2H0ejGwxG8hL4r/uCUuWwUBcRq7lQi8Mu/sK9D0cPr97DIKMUILndgwA=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/82Y1BXHF6Uiojy5pDtjPDw2?contactdata=4gISuyR4lkj0fuOwFG46gMKjI8PXeXTZu2e2D79IDwKvjhaeHq2i8mSMeHwiulpfqgXlI93I/di96nn1Z2Dn+qySgJedicUPmsL85ydOWFtXdylstoz2H0ejGwxG8hL4r/uCUuWwUBcRq7lQi8Mu/sK9D0cPr97DIKMUILndgwA=]
[https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] This week, our communities gathered in rage and grief for vigils [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/vigil-at-philadelphia-city-hall-calls-for-ice-accountability/4433451/] in memory of two men shot and killed by ICE.
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston was on his way to work when he was murdered. In Maine, ICE agents killed Joan Sebastian Guerrero with his three year old daughter in the backseat. Both were long-time, legal residents in their communities. Nobody’s suspected citizenship status should determine if they live or die. Yet, we have seen over half a dozen murdered by ICE, and 22 dead under ICE’s watch in inhumane detention facilities this year.
This is not normal. But this is the case if we continue to let ICE’s recklessness and violence run amok. Our communities, our neighborhoods, and our streets are not safe as long as ICE remains unchecked.
Right now, millions of Americans live in towns and counties that permit the local government to collaborate with ICE — including neighborhoods across Pennsylvania. We don’t want our local and state resources going to help an out-of-control agency target, harass, and attack our neighbors.
We’re calling on our leaders to be accountable to the communities they serve: Give Governor Shapiro a call at 717-287-2500 to ask him to end ICE collaboration in Pennsylvania. We deserve to live and thrive free from fear and harassment from ICE.
We’re standing in solidarity with communities in Texas and in Maine. We’re mourning with them, and we’re taking action with them on behalf of our neighbors and loved ones. We keep each other safe — and that starts with kicking ICE off our streets.
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=4gISuyR4lkj0fuOwFG46gMKjI8PXeXTZu2e2D79IDwKvjhaeHq2i8mSMeHwiulpfqgXlI93I/di96nn1Z2Dn+qySgJedicUPmsL85ydOWFtXdylstoz2H0ejGwxG8hL4r/uCUuWwUBcRq7lQi8Mu/sK9D0cPr97DIKMUILndgwA=]
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=4gISuyR4lkj0fuOwFG46gMKjI8PXeXTZu2e2D79IDwKvjhaeHq2i8mSMeHwiulpfqgXlI93I/di96nn1Z2Dn+qySgJedicUPmsL85ydOWFtXdylstoz2H0ejGwxG8hL4r/uCUuWwUBcRq7lQi8Mu/sK9D0cPr97DIKMUILndgwA=]
In solidarity,
Mohan Seshadri
Executive Director

---](https://substack.com/redirect/5f746f2f-e364-4b30-995d-5f0cad31f533?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Our argument was straightforward. Khanna is trying to rebrand himself as an anti-billionaire, anti-oligarch, working-class progressive while positioning himself for a possible presidential campaign. He travels around the country endorsing union workers, democratic socialists, and anti-establishment candidates, collecting the exact political relationships and photographs that help build that image.
Meanwhile, his household continues reporting thousands of stock trades worth tens of millions of dollars while he supports legislation that would prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from trading individual stocks.
That was the article.
[Ro Khanna](https://open.substack.com/users/263153691-ro-khanna?utm_source=mentions) responded with a 2,500-word Substack post claiming that our "real grievance" was his criticism of Israel and his trip to the West Bank.
There is one big fucking problem.
Our article did not mention Israel.
Not one word.
Ro Khanna's Substack
[Two Decades of a Clear and Progressive Record](https://substack.com/redirect/67253b5c-1364-4b69-90e6-d8acf3879d8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Matt Diemer published an attack on my record the day I arrived home from the West Bank. He has said for years that America must cherish its relationship with Israel. That is his real grievance. So here is my record...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/67253b5c-1364-4b69-90e6-d8acf3879d8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2 days ago * 351 likes * 74 comments * Ro Khanna
* * *
## Israel Was a Deflection
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ic8GY3PgGTFfRZm-Pjnza65VA74wVswUPWaPOpH09R8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=207223285)
Khanna pulled a quote from my 2022 congressional campaign. I told the [Cleveland Jewish News](https://substack.com/redirect/62485263-1269-4503-b08f-3cbe7d845cb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the United States should "uphold and cherish" its relationship with Israel.
Yes, I said that.
Supporting a relationship between two countries does not mean supporting every decision made by either government. More importantly, it had absolutely nothing to do with what Laura and I wrote.
We wrote about stock trading. We wrote about Khanna's family wealth. We wrote about his national endorsement strategy. We wrote about a politician supporting a congressional stock-trading ban while thousands of trades continue appearing in his household's financial disclosures.
Khanna came home from the West Bank with a story that was politically useful for his brand. He then attached our article to it and manufactured a fight about Israel that we never started.
**That is the grift.**
Khanna did not defend his actions. He changed the subject to something he is currently trying to establish himself as a national champion for. He turned our reporting into an attack on his West Bank trip because that was easier than answering questions about his portfolio.
Then he gave us his resume.
Iraq. Yemen. Bernie Sanders. The CHIPS Act. The Epstein files. Medicare for All. A $25 minimum wage. His books.
None of it answers the question.
It is easy to introduce legislation, support proposals, and talk about what you believe, especially when you know a bill has little chance of becoming law. The real test is whether you are willing to live under the standard you are selling to everyone else.
* * *
## Just Stop Trading
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/a42e4210-450e-4c5e-b1d8-64030aab2c41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Khanna says he does not personally buy or sell stocks. He says neither he nor his wife directs the trades. According to him, the investments are held in trusts established by his in-laws and managed by an independent third-party trustee.
The precise description is that Khanna's congressional disclosures reported thousands of transactions involving his household's trusts. [Common Cause attributed ](https://substack.com/redirect/a041cd83-2680-4496-9f15-51d3cd3a00d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[3,923 trades totaling approximately $55.7 million](https://substack.com/redirect/a041cd83-2680-4496-9f15-51d3cd3a00d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ to Khanna in its 2025.](https://substack.com/redirect/a041cd83-2680-4496-9f15-51d3cd3a00d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Ro Khanna's Money](https://substack.com/redirect/267e75a5-9315-4312-94c4-3dabe428845e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We are not alleging insider trading. We do not need to prove insider trading to make the ethical argument.
**The trades should not be happening at all.**
Khanna supports the TRUST in Congress Act, which would prohibit members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from trading individual stocks.
**Then stop trading.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c2b80c61-1ba5-4e1d-b3ac-da519fc2111a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This shit is becoming normalized
I do not care whether Khanna personally clicks the button, his wife chooses the stocks, or an independent trustee manages the account. His household reported thousands of individual stock trades while he was a sitting member of Congress.
There is no version of that I find ethically acceptable.
Members of Congress receive classified briefings. They regulate industries, approve federal contracts, investigate corporations, and make decisions that can move entire markets. Their households should not be actively trading individual companies while they hold that power.
We should not need hundreds of pages of financial disclosures, trust attorneys, forensic accountants, or explanations about which family member technically owns which asset.
Khanna says the trust underperformed the S&P 500. I do not give a shit. Losing to the market does not make thousands of trades ethical. A conflict or the appearance of a conflict does not disappear because the investment performed poorly.
Khanna does not need to wait for Congress to pass his bill. Sell the individual stocks. Move the money into diversified index funds, Treasury securities, or something that does not require thousands of individual trades while he serves in Congress.
Stand on business.
Live under the standard you are selling to everyone else.
* * *
## Apparently Losing Only Counts When We Do It
[Get 20% off for 1 year](https://substack.com/redirect/a42e4210-450e-4c5e-b1d8-64030aab2c41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Instead of answering that argument, Khanna looked up our election histories.
Laura ran against [Brian Poindexter](https://substack.com/redirect/61d3419e-eb4a-47bd-aa39-d8e60e1f3153?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the May 5 Democratic primary for Ohio's 7th Congressional District and lost. I ran for the same congressional seat in 2022 and 2024 and lost.
Those are facts.
What Khanna left out is that [Ohio's 7th District](https://substack.com/redirect/0366b0f5-cb7e-496c-b7c4-84e663b3f01f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was deliberately drawn to favor Republicans. It is difficult to run there as a Democrat, but somebody still has to stand up and do it. Candidates in difficult districts build local organizations, engage voters, recruit volunteers, raise money, and make sure Democrats have somebody on the ballot.
Khanna should understand that.
He lost his first two congressional campaigns. In his response, he presented his failed 2004 primary campaign as proof that he had the courage to challenge an entrenched incumbent.
Apparently, losing demonstrated courage when Ro Khanna did it. When Laura and I did it, our losses became opposition research.
Laura also brought more to her campaign than the one sentence Khanna gave her. She served for more than two decades across multiple federal agencies, working on healthcare, civil rights, emergency response, and public service. She ran for Congress using approximately **$12,000 of her savings** and rejected corporate PAC money.
Brian Poindexter benefited from at least **$570,204 in outside spending** from Jobs and Democracy PAC, according to FEC-based tracking. That super PAC operates within a political network heavily funded by interests connected to the artificial intelligence industry.
Khanna did not call Laura before endorsing. He did not examine her record or ask why outside money was pouring into an eight-person Democratic primary.
Khanna can endorse whoever he wants. But he cannot spend years criticizing the Democratic establishment for putting its thumb on the scale, enter an Ohio primary and add his thumb to the pile, and then dismiss Laura as a sore loser when she questions his hypocrisy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/495cd63c-485a-428c-82dc-90e0b1126bb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
## Do Not Use Brian Poindexter as a Shield
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ic8GY3PgGTFfRZm-Pjnza65VA74wVswUPWaPOpH09R8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=207223285)
Our original article was not an attack on [Brian Poindexter.](https://substack.com/redirect/61d3419e-eb4a-47bd-aa39-d8e60e1f3153?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It was about what Khanna receives from endorsing candidates like him.
Brian gives Khanna a union ironworker in working-class Ohio. Other endorsements give him democratic socialists, rural candidates, Midwestern relationships, and access to local political networks far outside Silicon Valley.
Khanna receives photographs, relationships, fundraising opportunities, labor credibility, email lists, and a national story about how a wealthy congressman from Silicon Valley understands working people across America.
That is extremely useful for somebody thinking about running for president.
Instead of addressing that strategy, Khanna placed Brian between himself and our criticism. He turned questions about his own political ambition into an alleged attack on a union worker.
Do not borrow a worker's credibility and then hide behind him when somebody asks what you are getting from the relationship.
And do not use Brian's biography to protect Ro Khanna's portfolio.
* * *
## Why Did He Choose Us?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ic8GY3PgGTFfRZm-Pjnza65VA74wVswUPWaPOpH09R8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=207223285)
Khanna has faced questions about his household's trading from researchers, national publications, political opponents, and people with audiences numbering in the millions.
But he chose to write 2,500 words about two former congressional candidates publishing a small newsletter in Ohio.
Maybe we looked like the easiest targets.
Khanna could point to our election losses and dismiss us as bitter. He could use my four-year-old quote about Israel to invent a secret motive. He could make himself look like a fighter without directly engaging the people filing complaints or publishing detailed financial analyses.
He could not make the financial disclosures disappear.
But maybe he thought he could discredit us.
So, genuinely, thank you for the attention, Congressman Khanna. Thank you for tagging The Angry Democrats and putting our criticism in front of your audience.
But next time, respond to the article we actually wrote.
* * *
## A Warning to Candidates
Candidates receiving Khanna's attention should understand that the relationship is not one-sided.
Maybe Khanna sincerely believes in you. We hope he does.
But he is also using your campaign to build his political image. Your background gives him credibility. Your supporters become part of his network. Your campaign becomes evidence that a wealthy Silicon Valley congressman understands labor, rural America, democratic socialism, or whatever political lane he is trying to enter that week.
Do not confuse national attention with friendship.
Do not allow your biography, campaign, or working-class credibility to become somebody else's political costume.
And pay attention to what Khanna did when his own record was questioned. He placed Brian Poindexter between himself and criticism that had nothing to do with Brian.
Ro Khanna knows how to use people.
Make sure you are not next.
* * *
## **Stay Angry.**
Every dollar funds coverage you can read and the worked needed to curate the stories, strategy, and analysis to bring you the information you need to know.
[Give once](https://substack.com/redirect/7bcd8d19-48af-44ad-abfc-90ae4af1ea9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Then hold us to it.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Her campaign spent literally zero dollars
disclaimer_text:
paid for by
super PACs
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Abdul for US Senate

AIPAC and allied super PACs have now spent over $50 million to prop up
Haley Stevens on TV and digital ads. If we don't answer right now, that
money decides this race.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260716-3-ak.QPGkhi&amount=10&refcode=em20260716-2646&t=1004&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Chip in $10 amount right now to fight back, or keep
reading and I'll show you the “receipts.”

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260716-3-ak.QPGkhi&amount=10&refcode=em20260716-2646&t=1005&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Donate $10 ››

Peter, here's
the part of this that is almost impossible to believe.

Until today — July 16 — Haley Stevens hadn't spent a dime of her own
campaign's money on TV ads. Not one.

Every single ad you've seen propping her up was bought and paid for by
super PACs. In fact, AIPAC's front group "UDP" just booked another
multi-million dollar TV buy for her, blanketing Detroit, Grand Rapids,
Lansing, Flint, and Traverse City all at once. They even bought time
during Tigers games.

Why would special interests spend $50 million on a candidate who won't
spend her own money? Because they want something in return. That's not a
campaign. That's a purchase. It's legalized bribery at its worst.

And I have to level with you: it's working. After all that spending, two
new polls put her slightly ahead of us in this race.

This is the part where I'm supposed to tell you it's all going to be fine.
I won't. I'm going to tell you the truth instead, because the best advice
I ever got in politics came from Bernie Sanders: my job is to get really
good at telling the truth.

So here's the truth. This race stopped being about one Senate seat a long
time ago.

If a super PAC can spend $50 million to buy a Senate seat in Michigan,
they can buy any seat, anywhere, forever. Every politician in America is
watching this race to learn one lesson: do you have to earn people's
votes, or can you just rent their airwaves? If the money wins here, the
message to every future candidate is simple — don't bother knocking doors,
don't bother listening to anybody, just go kiss the ring.

That's not democracy. It’s oligarchy on a payment plan.

They are not spending $50 million because they think they're winning.
They're spending it because a campaign that takes zero corporate money is
a few weeks away from beating them, and they’re desperate to stop us. I'm
the only candidate in this race who's never taken a dime of corrupt
special interest money, and they know exactly what that means for them if
I win.

We will never match them dollar for dollar. We don't have to. We have to
reach undecided voters with our own ads, our own organizers, our own story
— before AIPAC's version of it is the only one they ever hear. Campaigns
that can tell their own story survive this playbook. Campaigns that run
dry get buried by it.

That takes money, and there are only 19 days left to spend it. So I'm
making a hard ask, harder than I like to make:

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260716-3-ak.QPGkhi&amount=10&refcode=em20260716-2646&t=1006&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Donate $10 amount right now — or whatever you can afford
— so the last three weeks of this race are decided by people, not by a $50
million check.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260716-3-ak.QPGkhi&amount=10&refcode=em20260716-2646&t=1025&akid=2649%2E251025%2EdP9V_Z ]Donate $10 ››

They have the money. We have you. I wouldn't trade.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this help us stay connected with grassroots supporters like you, so thank you for taking the time to read this message. To contribute via check, please address it to Abdul for U.S. Senate, PO Box 126, St. Clair Shores, MI 48080.

We've been divided on purpose.

For 20 years, I've worked alongside farmers and city planners, union members and small business owners, people who've never voted the same way twice -- and what I've learned is this: partisanship is not our nature. It's been manufactured.
We're being distracted and conquered by the billionaire class and the politicians who serve them - on both sides. Our neighbors aren't our enemies. We've been trained to forget that.

That's why I signed the Purple Pledge -- not a Democratic pledge, not a Republican pledge. An American pledge.

Put country before party. Tell the truth. Protect our democracy. Honor our seniors, our veterans, our families. Invest in the next generation. Hold every official to the same code of ethics. No exceptions.

These aren't radical ideas. They're the ideas most of us already believe. We've just forgotten we all agree on them.

I'm not waiting for someone else to fix this. I signed the pledge. Now I'm asking you to join me in living it.

Care. Courage. The Constitution.
Vote Melissa for Congress.

body:
Survivors and the public deserve transparency and answers.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260716-6480-footer&t=1&akid=6480%2E420207%2E4Y5miV)
Peter,
**No one is above accountability.**
And yet the Department of Justice is _**withholding**_ unredacted records from New Mexico officials investigating Jeffrey Epstein’s former Zorro Ranch. New Mexico’s Attorney General has made clear these documents are _critical_ to moving the investigation forward — and every day of delay makes it harder to hold anyone responsible.
Survivors deserve the truth. The public deserves the truth.
Instead of helping uncover it, the DOJ is putting up barriers that make accountability harder to achieve. This isn't just about one investigation. It's about whether our justice system protects the powerful or delivers justice equally.
**No matter how wealthy, connected, or influential someone is, they should never be above the law.**
That means standing with survivors, demanding transparency, and refusing to let institutions hide the truth when it's politically convenient.
**I'll keep fighting for accountability and a justice system that works for everyone—but I can't do it alone.[**If you’re with me, will you sign on to my petition demanding the Trump administration stop stonewalling the Epstein investigations?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260716-epstein-petition-1/?source=em20260716-6480&amount=3&t=2&akid=6480%2E420207%2E4Y5miV)**

body:

Peter,

A little over 100 days until Election Day. That’s how long our Squad —
Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida — has to defend their seats.

And corporate PACs and special interests know it.

They're recruiting primary challengers. They’re running ads. They're
funneling money through shadow groups. They will do whatever it takes to
remove our four progressive voices from Congress.

Here's what they can't buy: this grassroots movement.

The Squad Victory Fund is different because just like our champions, we
don’t bow down to outside forces. We don’t take corporate cash. We don’t
ask billionaires for money.

We’re powered by thousands of people chipping in $5, $10, or whatever they
can, building something no check can replicate. We know the only way to
win is with the backing of this team — knocking on doors, making calls,
registering voters, and showing up again and again in this final stretch.

Yesterday, I voted with 99 other Democratic Representatives to stop sending $3.3 billion a year to Israel’s genocidal military. The amendment didn’t pass, but our movement has built real power to cut off support for ethnic cleansing. But I’m the only member of Congress from Michigan who voted for that amendment.I need an ally in Michigan’s Congressional delegation who will work to end U.S. support for genocide, and who will demand that our tax dollars fund our communities: Donavan McKinney. Like me, Donavan McKinney and Dave Zeglen don’t take corporate PAC money. They have both been union organizers and champions for working class families. They’re standing up to corporate polluters and dreaming big about what our communities deserve. We need democratic socialist, pro-Palestine, pro-union, and anti-ICE leaders who are working to get big money out of politics — from the local level up to the federal level. Donavan is running against a multi-millionaire incumbent who has spent $17 million of his own money to bankroll his campaigns , while using our tax dollars on ads to promote himself. Donavan’s opponent is also a genocide enabler who voted to sanction the International Criminal Court after the ICC issued an arrest warrant for Benjamin Netanyahu. The member of Congress representing one of the country’s poorest districts (the congressional district next to mine) must be deeply rooted in the community — like Donavan, who grew up poor and understands his constituents’ struggles. He’ll move with urgency to invest in our communities’ needs, rather than sending our tax dollars to fund war crimes. Dave Zeglen is also rooted in his community and is taking on private utility companies, AI data centers, and the fossil fuel industry — while fighting for tenants’, students’, and workers’ rights. Dave and Donavan are working toward environmental justice as well as free healthcare, education, and housing for all. We need them in public office. I need allies in Congress and in Michigan who understand the struggles of our communities ― from unaffordable groceries to gas prices to insurance, utilities, housing, and healthcare — and who will fight for the big solutions that we need in order to meet the scale of our crises. Thank you for always having my back and for supporting the deeply progressive allies we need fighting for us and alongside us in Congress and in our communities. Peter, did you see this from POLITICO?
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk936&amount=10&t=8&akid=2146%2E124072%2EKCL_aF)
**North Carolina Republicans are warning that it will be hard to beat Roy Cooper – unless Washington sends more money, fast.**
I’ll explain why this is important in a second, but if you can, [**_please chip in to our campaign by using this link._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk936&amount=10&t=9&akid=2146%2E124072%2EKCL_aF)
You’ve probably seen that, right now, a lot of people think we can win this race and flip North Carolina blue. I know we can, and I know that winning here is the first step to taking back control of the Senate.
You’ve probably also heard us talk about the recent Supreme Court ruling that allows political parties to spend unlimited amounts of money on their campaigns, and how it means that my opponent Michael Whatley – the former chair of the Republican National Committee – is likely first in line for the $125 million war chest that the RNC has stockpiled.
Well, this POLITICO article is a big red warning light. The NCGOP knows that we can win this race and flip the Senate, and by going to the national media, they’re begging for Washington DC elites like the RNC and outside dark money groups to come to Whatley’s rescue.
I know that we can beat them, but I need to tell you, it’s going to take all of us. A new poll shows my lead shrinking, and the RNC and other groups could spend hundreds of millions of dollars in North Carolina to beat us – in fact, Whatley himself recently said he expects there to be $600 million spent here.
[**_It seems like a lot, I know. But every race I’ve won, I’ve won it with the help of folks like you joining together. And we can do it again today. If you’re able, please chip in $10 right now to help us win this race._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk936&amount=10&t=10&akid=2146%2E124072%2EKCL_aF)

Graham Platner is out--and on this episode of _**Tequila Talk**_ , [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions), former Republican congressman [Joe Walsh](https://open.substack.com/users/263371025-joe-walsh?utm_source=mentions), and Chicago radio host [Richard Chew - ChewsViews](https://open.substack.com/users/8133974-richard-chew-chewsviews?utm_source=mentions) pour a round and dig into what his implosion says about the Democratic Party. The fabricated excuses, the tattoo he lied about, the racist posts, and the sexual-misconduct allegations were all, the three agree, avoidable--the product of a party that rushes to anoint candidates and skips the vetting. From Maine to Michigan, the same pattern keeps handing Republicans, in Richard's mother's words, "the stick to beat you with."
But the conversation is really about something bigger: a party at war with itself. Walsh calls it the Democrats' "Tea Party moment"; Chew reframes it as a reckoning with the "old guard"--the Schumer-and-Jeffries leadership that, all three argue, refuses to fight. They make the case for righteous anger over decorum, for tagging Susan Collins every single day rather than waiting for an October surprise, and for candidates who take responsibility instead of pointing fingers. It is a blunt, funny, occasionally profane hour and twenty minutes about why Democrats keep beating themselves -- and the surprisingly simple path to winning in 2026.

**Abbott may have started this race with $106 million in his war chest, but that doesn’t mean he gets to buy another four years in the Governor’s mansion.**

Every dollar we raise right now helps fund the voter contact, outreach, and organizing we need to compete across Texas. Abbott will spend millions trying to distract voters from how unpopular he is and how badly he has failed working families.
